name: Paralytic Weapon
body:
Price +5,000 gp; Slot weapon; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

A paralytic weapon delivers a pulsing electrical charge that 1d2 points of nonlethal electricity damage on a hit, in addition to any damage caused by the weapon itself. In addition, a living creature struck is staggered for 1 round (DC 11 Fort negates). A target struck more than once per round with the same paralytic weapon attempts only a single save, but the DC increases by 1 for each hit after the first. If any of the hits is a critical hit, the target is paralyzed for 1 round rather than being staggered, with this paralysis beginning at the end of the attacker’s turn.

This ability can also be applied to ranged weapons, such as a bow, crossbow, sling, or firearm, with the weapon conferring the effect on its ammunition (which must be made of metal to conduct the electricity) as it is launched, but once the target is hit or missed, the projectile loses its charge. This power is ineffective if a paralytic weapon is thrown.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Technological Item; Equipment nanotech lab; Craft DC 20; Cost 2,500 gp
